_comment: Curated under-review drug rows for build_drug_pages.py -- programs with a live FDA application but NO publicly disclosed action date, so no dataset event row can honestly carry them (a dataset row needs a date; inventing one violates the precision rules). Audit 2026-08-18c: AI grounding queries cite us for these drugs ('pdufa date for daraonrasib in usa' -- 14 citations, 47 Bing impressions, no page). The truthful answer to that query is 'the FDA accepted the application on X; no action date has been made public' -- and that answer is this file. Every row carries its primary source. when_text is rendered where a date would be; st 'Under review' marks the row live-but-undated.

rows.when_text: NDA accepted 2026-07-22; action date not public
rows.name: Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236)

_d.indication: Previously treated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
_d.review: NDA accepted for review 2026-07-22 on the Phase 3 RASolute 302 trial (all primary and key secondary endpoints met, incl. overall survival). Breakthrough Therapy and Orphan Drug designations; selected for the FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher pilot. No PDUFA goal date has been publicly disclosed.
_d.also_searched_note: People searching for this drug frequently type "daraonrasib", dropping the x. It is the same molecule: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236).

rows.when_text: PDUFA date extended 2026-05-27; new action date not public
rows.name: Camizestrant

_d.indication: 1st-line HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer with an emergent ESR1 mutation, in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (SERENA-6)
_d.review: NDA accepted July 2025 on the Phase 3 SERENA-6 trial; Breakthrough Therapy Designation May 2025. The Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee voted 3-6 against on 2026-04-30; the FDA extended the PDUFA date (announced 2026-05-27) to review additional ctDNA-clearance analyses. The new action date has not been publicly disclosed.
